Updates `marked` from 18.1.1 to 18.1.2
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">marked's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>v18.1.2</h2>
<h2><a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">18.1.2</a> (2026-10-26)</h2>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li>allow a tab or end of input after a type 6 html block tag name (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4128</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">e09c40d</a>)</li>
<li>apply emphasis flanking and rules 9-10 to the whole delimiter run (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4145</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">5d8e234</a>)</li>
<li><strong>cli:</strong> await config functions before parsing (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4138</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">3a11ad1</a>)</li>
<li><strong>cli:</strong> create no-clobber output files atomically (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4135</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">e7c4f64</a>)</li>
<li>do not continue a block quote paragraph from a whitespace-only line (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4134</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">42f34a8</a>)</li>
<li>expand a tab after the block quote marker to the next tab stop (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4110</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">2d3899b</a>)</li>
<li>honor per-call async options when composing hooks (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4139</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">379be9d</a>)</li>
<li>keep a line starting with # but no space in the list item (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4127</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">6b63189</a>)</li>
<li>keep duplicate link definitions in the tokens (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4132</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">2784acc</a>)</li>
<li>keep lazy lines after a list in a nested blockquote (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4137</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">38c7e55</a>)</li>
<li>keep lazy setext underlines in list items as text (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4126</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">398234c</a>)</li>
<li>render nested image alt formatting as plain text (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4131</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">15f59bb</a>)</li>
<li>stop an unclosed inline raw tag from unescaping later blocks (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4130</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">4562b6f</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Performance Improvements</h3>
<ul>
<li>~16% faster parsing by skipping em/strong masking for runs without *, _ or ~ (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#4142</a>) (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">f0fd3e0</a>)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
